final: WITH media_type_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) as rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate FROM media_type_rates) SELECT mtr.Name, mtr.rate, mtr.rate / om.mean_rate as rate_divided_by_overall_mean FROM media_type_rates mtr, overall_mean om ORDER BY mtr.Name
